dedupe_keys.name: dhlgh foreshore offshore renewable energy data

description: DHLGH Foreshore Offshore Renewable Energy Data is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Climate, Energy and the Environment. Offshore Renewable Energy: Potential Foreshore Site Investigation licence locations related to potential offshore renewable energy related infrastructure, and current offshore renewable energy project locations. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Climate, Energy and the Environment. Its tags are Foreshore ORE data, Marine Spatial Planning, open data. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
